name: 72(t) Calculator
meta_title: 72(t) Calculator: SEPP Early Withdrawals from an IRA
meta_description: Work out penalty-free 72(t) early withdrawals from an IRA or 401(k) with the RMD, amortization and annuitization methods under IRS Notice 2022-6.
subtitle: Work out the yearly withdrawals you can take from an IRA or workplace plan before age 59½ without the 10% additional tax, using the three IRS methods for substantially equal periodic payments.
